name: Verify clear message when user has no open tickets
objective: Validate that the assistant provides a clear message when the user has no open tickets in the system.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. User has no open tickets.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Verify the assistant provides a clear message about no tickets
steps.expectedResult: The assistant clearly states that no open tickets exist for the user
